title.zh: 场景化表格与数据交付

text.zh:
优先移动端可读性。常规文字输出默认使用一、二、三级列表，不默认使用 Markdown 表格。邮件、纯文本和 Markdown 输出禁止直接塞入复杂表格；用户需要表格数据时优先提供 CSV 供导入 Excel，用户显式要求查看表格时按其要求展示，并保证可读性。

HTML 和 PPT 可以使用符合设计规范的表格。HTML 使用原生 table 结构；PPT 自行绘制表格时使用可编辑的原生表格。常规汇报优先采用 Excel 表格截图，避免无必要地在 PPT 中重新绘制。版本交付可以先给正文，并根据交付需要把表格作为补充或妥协方案；仍须满足已约定的交付完整性、数据准确性和两端阅读要求。
text.en:
Prioritize readability on mobile. Ordinary text output defaults to first-, second- and third-level lists and does not default to Markdown tables. Do not stuff complex tables directly into email, plain text or Markdown output; when the user needs table data, provide a CSV for import into Excel, and when the user explicitly asks to see a table, show it as requested while keeping it readable.

HTML and PPT may use tables that follow the design guidelines. HTML uses the native table structure; when a PPT draws its own table, use an editable native table. For routine reports prefer a screenshot of the Excel table and avoid redrawing it in PPT without need. A version delivery may give the body first and, as the delivery needs, supply the table as a supplement or compromise, while still meeting the agreed completeness, data accuracy and reading requirements on both ends.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 输出文字内容、表格数据或汇报材料时
trigger.en: When producing text output, table data or report materials

purpose.zh: 优先保证移动端可读，并以列表与 CSV 等方式交付数据
purpose.en: Prioritize mobile readability and deliver data as lists and CSV

exclude.zh: 用户显式要求查看表格的情形；HTML、PPT 中符合设计规范的表格
exclude.en: When the user explicitly asks to see a table; tables in HTML and PPT that follow the design guidelines
